notes.title: Update notes for September 2025
notes.notes:
What's new in this update:
Achievements: 20 new achievements. Some of them can only be acquired in levels with certain buffs.

Click heat: Players were clicking too fast and were missing much of the game experience. The Click Heat buildup prevents that.

Fixed red cross legal issues

notes.title: Update notes for August 2025
notes.notes:
New month, new update!

 Enemies now have healthbars which gives more room for tactics
 Added enemy variability
 Added Stats
 Better healing animations
 More gameplay music tracks
 Bugfixes:

 Mission freezing after playing a level with inspect buttons
 Mortar bug freezing game on restart
